sentences.en: I feel disenchanted by the limited capacity of the computer.
sentences.zh: 我对这台计算机有限的容量感到失望。

sentences.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
sentences.zh: 人类有能力适应环境变化。

sentences.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
sentences.zh: 这些细胞能够将食物转化为能量。

senses.zh: 能力，才能；容积，容纳能力；职位，职责

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cap（拿）+acity（表状态、情况）→能拿住→容量
